completeness.statement: Includes all 1,666 revenue-village source rows, all 78 taluks and all 14 districts from the pinned LGD snapshot, augmented with available named OpenStreetMap place nodes. Informal localities, alternate spellings, recently changed names and unmapped places may be missing. It is not a complete register of every Kerala place or a verified list of categories operating in Kerala.
completeness.deduplication: Same normalized settlement name within the same district is merged, retaining source references. Separate district and taluk records remain. Distinct settlements sharing a name inside one district can be merged; source IDs preserve provenance for later review.
completeness.districtAssignment: Point-in-polygon against simplified district boundaries from the pinned LGD/Survey of India-derived bundle. Coastal and boundary points without a polygon match are excluded unless an explicit OSM district tag resolves them.
